# opnsense_dyndns_settings (Resource)

Dynamic DNS service settings (**Services ▸ Dynamic DNS ▸ Settings**, plugin `os-ddclient`): service, backend, check interval and IPv6. Accounts are `opnsense_dyndns_account` resources. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `dyndns_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_dyndns_settings.this
  id = "dyndns_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_dyndns_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowipv6` (Boolean) Allow IPv6 for updates.
- `backend` (String) Select the backend to use. One of `ddclient`, `opnsense`.
- `daemon_delay` (Number) Interval in seconds to check for address changes. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable ddclient.
- `verbose` (Boolean) Enable verbose logging.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `dyndns_settings`.
